core_obligations: The author counts proper colorings by the number of correct guesses, introduces an auxiliary recoloring graph between one-correct and multiple-correct colorings, and combines degree bounds in that graph with conditional proper-coloring expectations. A two-regime normalization inequality yields the explicit joint n/Delta quadratic bound. This is the proper-game extension of the method, with non-neighbor/proper-coloring constraints controlling the recolorings; random-graph and linear consequences are bundled.
